data.one_liner: Pick animated GIFs from Giphy in Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget-based picker for animated GIFs from the Giphy API. It returns a Gif object that can be displayed with GiphyImage or a standard Image widget.
use_when: You need to let users select animated GIFs in your app
You want a ready‑made picker with customization options
You already have a Giphy API key
avoid_when: You don't use Giphy or need a different GIF source
You prefer a fully custom picker implementation
strengths: Easy integration with a single API key
weaknesses: Limited to Giphy as the source
data.setup_notes: Register an app on Giphy Developers Portal to obtain an API key. Pass the key to GiphyPicker.pickGif. No build_runner or native permissions needed.
data.minimal_example: final gif = await GiphyPicker.pickGif(context: context, apiKey: '[YOUR GIPHY APIKEY]');
